SDCard Block Address

Absolute Address:
Base Offset:
0x20
Size:
0x4
Source:
adc_acquisition_reg_definition.rdl

Description

Current CMD24 argument for the HW copy engine in ACQ_SDCARD mode. Software sets the starting value; hardware advances it after each block by the amount SDCARD_ADDR_MODE selects (see there). Units (block number vs. byte address) are also selected by SDCARD_ADDR_MODE.

Contents

Bits Identifier Access Reset Decoded Name
[31:0] BLOCK_ADDR rw 0x0 Block Address

Field Descriptions

BLOCK_ADDR - Block Address

CMD24 argument -- a block number or a byte address, per SDCARD_ADDR_MODE
